messages:
sylvie: Quick follow-up from the postmortem (INC-5842). We've fixed the immediate gaps, but this keeps recurring. Need guardrails and a short triage plan so backfills don't become the norm.
rahul: I can take a pass at automated watermarks for ETL partitions 16 idea: maintain last-processed-watermark per partition and alert if lag > X minutes. Will draft a PR by Friday.
keisha: I'll own aggregation correctness smoke tests. Plan: add synthetic traces with edge-case timings and a fast e2e check that runs after deploys. ETA: Tue.
elsa: I'll update the runbook and add a pre-merge CI check that runs the new aggregation unit tests. Also adding a one-click reprocess button in staging runbook.
sylvie: Good. Can we also add a low-noise trend dashboard that surfaces recurring droops (3x in 6 months) so product can see impact?
rahul: Yep. I'll add a 90-day recurrence chart for processed_span_count vs raw_events and a small anomaly detector that flags repeated dips.
keisha: For the nightly smoke, let's make the tolerance strict for newly merged aggregation changes (e.g., fail if >0.2% span loss). If noise, we can auto-create OBS-CI tickets instead of paging.
elsa: Runbook note: add steps to (1) force compaction on a partition, (2) kick a re-ingest, (3) run the equivalence query. I'll link example SQL snippets.
ops-bot: Created ticket OBS-3001: "etl-watermark-guardrail" assigned to rahul (due 2026-04-10).
ops-bot: Created ticket OBS-3002: "aggregation-smoke-tests" assigned to keisha (due 2026-04-06).
sylvie: One more ask: schedule a monthly 30-min "obs regression trends" sync. Action items from owners should be 2 bullets in their tickets by EOD Monday. I'll compile for infra/product prioritization.
rahul: Will add watermark design + alert thresholds.
keisha: Adding test matrix and expected failure modes.
elsa: Adding runbook snippets and staging links.
sylvie: Thanks all, closing thread until tickets have bullets. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
